purpose: Root normalizes saved literal evidence after all actual endpoints close. This contract supplies no outcomes or sample candidates.

top_level.lead: String; human report lead, LaTeX supported by MathJax.
top_level.outcome: String; actual qualified scope and unresolved outcomes, with no assumed pass count.
top_level.runs: Ordered list of separately measured endpoint objects. Empty is allowed.
top_level.links: List of {label,href} evidence/review links. Relative HTTP-hosted paths or https URLs.

run_fields.label: Human endpoint label.
run_fields.qualified: Exact boolean or null. Only true displays endpoint qualification.
run_fields.seconds: Finite numeric native launch-through-postprobe seconds, or null. Never a per-method or combined endpoint timing.
run_fields.status: Actual endpoint status string, including UNKNOWN/failure where applicable.
run_fields.cases: List of {name,status}. Empty when no case record returned; do not convert expected cases into observed passes/skips. Optional state/proposal/receipt/record/links fields may supply a particular case's own evidence.
run_fields.state: Flat saved original8 or marked9 point-state object, or null. No engine or model reconstruction is performed by the reader.
run_fields.proposal: Whole selected actual proposer record or null. Its fibre_cover is labeled untrusted unless a checked census is present.
run_fields.receipt: Whole selected actual independent checker receipt or null. New schema unit-row-marked-aware-nonimp-fibre-check-v1 provides checked_candidates, checked_fibre_cover and full current state. Do not synthesize these fields from an untrusted proposal.
run_fields.record: Whole saved record or bounded explanatory metadata, or null; shown as literal JSON.
run_fields.links: List of {label,href} linking exact actual evidence, disposition, Source and reviews.

rendering_rules: Candidate portraits and point tables use only receipt.checked_candidates. No fallback to proposal.candidates, reconstructed tiles, expected witnesses or static fixtures.
All formula ASTs are rendered as LaTeX with MathJax. Literal consecutive not nodes are accurately compressed as a counted sequence of negations; C42 is41 negations of bot, not the target theorem.

Colored dots come only from actual global_m_values; squares come only from global_t_values. The compact table is symbolic coordinate data, not physical tile geometry. No rotations/reflections or matching runs.
Read obligations preserve the actual ordered list, row/formula/occupied/fact_accepted fields. Pending unoccupied requirements are never labeled proven facts.
Receipt completeness and exact degree are displayed separately. Null degree is not zero; TWO_OR_MORE is a lower bound and alternatives are not a compatible cluster.
If a selected case has summary fields only, the page explicitly labels displayed data as endpoint primary evidence, not that case's own receipt.
Missing or failed endpoints render without invented cases, candidate packets, degree or qualification. If qualified is not true, evidence remains explicitly unqualified.

No full-language count, scientific acceptance or performance conclusion is inferred. The key-list length is displayed only as the length of that saved array. Displaying a saved receipt does not run its checker.
deployment: Root integrates actual data, performs visual/data QA, packages and publishes to existing marked-domains/ destination. Author writes only this task-owned Source folder.
authoring_validation: Raw file/C0 inspection and JavaScript syntax check only. No model imports/functions, actual-data rendering tests, scientific calls or clocks.
